title: Medical Log 02:00 Sunday and Draft 4-Hour Update

fields.logSource: Medical Center count register / VSP report drafts / ship message relay

lines.msg: Count entry opened by nurse in charge: pre-arrival count, Sun 21 Feb 02:00. Basis: cumulative reportable AGE cases since embarkation 14 Feb.
COUNT 02:00: CUMULATIVE PASSENGERS 118 (4.0% of 2,980). CUMULATIVE CREW 31 (2.8% of 1,120). New since 24:00: 3 passengers, 1 crew.

Death on board: 1. Guest A, cabin code P-8417, time of death Sat 20 Feb 15:02, cause UNKNOWN, AGE case status: not a case. Reported to the CDC Quarantine Station, Houston, Sat 20 Feb 15:40 (phone and electronic message).
Count entry 02:00 SIGNED: Dr. Fiona Gallagher, Chief Medical Officer.
Distribution queued: Hotel Director, Master, shoreside Public Health.
Template opened: VSP 4-hour update. Reference: 24-hour report transmitted Fri 19 Feb 20:05, PASSENGERS 74, CREW 17. ETA Galveston 07:00 Sun 21 Feb.
Draft saved by doctor on duty, VSP 4-hour update. Note line: 'Cases since 24-hour report: PASSENGERS 44, CREW 14'. Field 'Cumulative cases': PASSENGERS 44, CREW 14. Field 'On board': 2,980 / 1,120.
Draft VSP 4-hour update status UNSIGNED. Signature blocks empty: CMO / Master / Shoreside PH confirms receipt. Transmit by 03:00 for 07:00 arrival.

MSG RELAY inbound. FROM: ops-desk@gulfterminalservices.example TO: fleetops@halcyonreach.example SUBJECT: Halcyon Dawn arrival Sun 21 Feb. 'Please confirm your ETA and whether disembarkation will still run 07:30-10:30. We have 14 buses and 2 security lanes booked for your next-voyage check-in from 13:00, and the port police want your berth-time update by 05:00. Gulf Terminal Services, Galveston terminal operations.'
MSG RELAY: copy of 02:25 message routed to bridge and Medical Center queue.

fields.classification: CONFIDENTIAL - MEDICAL RECORD - SHIP AND SHORESIDE USE ONLY

instructorNote: Core inject: the draft puts the increase since the first report (44 passengers, 14 crew) in the 'Cumulative cases' field. The CMO should correct it to 118 and 31, then the CMO signs, the Master countersigns and PH confirms receipt, all before the 03:00 deadline. Also watch for PH copying the county and state health departments, and for OPS answering the terminal operator and the port with the 07:00 ETA and the disembarkation plan before 05:00.
